svg.title: A charge-neutral bulk with a boundary-imposed electric field
svg.desc: A one-dimensional boundary-value problem in a homogeneous conductor. Panel a is a continuum bulk region between prescribed boundaries phi(0)=V and phi(L)=0, with V positive and constant permittivity. There are no particle dots or particle trajectories. Its only interior arrow is the electric field, in the positive x direction. Carrier and background densities are equal: n=N_D, rho=e(N_D-n)=0. Panel b shows phi/V=1-x/L. Panel c shows E_x/(V/L)=1 on the same spatial interval. The field is minus the potential slope; zero field divergence does not imply zero field. No conductivity or current-voltage law is assumed in this electrostatic figure.
svg.text: Boundary voltage and the electric field
